title: MetricEvent
description: Canonical telemetry metric event for website traffic congestion prediction.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the monitored website or application service

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC when the metric snapshot was captured

active_users.description: Number of concurrent active users / sessions during the snapshot interval

request_rate.description: Requests per second (RPS) received during the interval

error_rate_percent.description: Percentage of requests resulting in 4xx/5xx HTTP errors (0.0 to 100.0)
